description: List active (incomplete) tasks / to-do items from Todoist. Optionally filter by a project id, or by a Todoist filter query (a powerful query language, e.g. "today | overdue", "p1 & #Work", "no date"). Returns each task's id, content, description, project id, priority, due date/datetime, labels, and web URL.

filter.description: Optional Todoist filter query to select tasks, e.g. "today | overdue", "p1", "#Work & no date", "7 days". See Todoist's filter query language.

project_id.description: Optional project id to restrict tasks to a single Todoist project (from todoist_list_projects).

name: todoist_list_tasks
title: Todoist List Tasks
